tasks.title: Define password policy validation and character groups
tasks.dod: Policy validation accepts only lengths 4–128 with at least one group and enough length for each selected group; focused unit tests pass.

tasks.title: Implement unbiased Web Crypto password generation
tasks.dod: A generation function produces only selected groups, includes each selected group, and passes deterministic boundary tests plus random-source tests.

tasks.title: Extend local history for consent and retained records
tasks.dod: History remains disabled by default, persists only after consent, survives reload, stops new writes when disabled, and clears on request; adapter tests pass.

tasks.title: Build password-policy controls
tasks.dod: The generator UI exposes length and all four character groups, shows validation feedback, and passes meaningful UI tests.

tasks.title: Render generated password and clipboard behavior
tasks.dod: The UI renders a generated password, copies it on request, confirms success, and shows a retryable failure state; unit and UI tests pass.

tasks.title: Build history consent and history-management UI
tasks.dod: The UI warns before opt-in, displays retained history after reopening, disables future saves without deleting existing records, and clears records on request.

tasks.title: Wire the complete generator widget into the home route
tasks.dod: The home route composes the completed widget without layer-rule violations and all existing application checks pass.

tasks.title: Add end-to-end password-generator coverage
tasks.dod: Browser tests cover generation, invalid policy, copy success and failure, consent, retained history, disabling, and clearing; the full test suite passes.
